about: The reveal's estimate (the spec's 'Reveal odds'), shared by the slot model's reveal_chance (tools/crafting_helper/slot_model.py) and the engine's twin. Each case gives n, the exclusive modifiers that can be offered on the revealed side (exclusive_pool); h, the aimed ones among them, a tier share possibly fractional (exclusive_hits); q, the chance one Exalted Orb draw on that side adds an aimed ordinary modifier, 0 with none aimed and null when unknown (ordinary); whether Omen of Abyssal Echoes' reroll counts (echoes); and the chance one reveal offers a target, null when unknown (chance), worked by hand from the spec with the equal-weight default on. A recorded chance is never edited to match the model or the engine: a difference is a spec or model defect.

cases.about: A ring revealing a prefix: seven exclusive prefixes can be offered, one is the target, no ordinary target on the side. The guaranteed exclusive option is the target one time in seven.
As exclusive-only, with Omen of Abyssal Echoes: 1 - (6/7)^2 = 13/49.
A body armour revealing a prefix (no exclusive prefix on the class): three exalt-like draws, each hitting the ordinary target with chance 0.1: 1 - 0.9^3.
As no-pool, with Omen of Abyssal Echoes: 1 - 0.729^2.
Ten exclusive modifiers can be offered and none is aimed; an ordinary target with chance 0.1 per draw fills one of the two drawn options: 1 - 0.9^2.
One of ten exclusive modifiers aimed and an ordinary target with chance 0.2 per draw: 1 - 0.9 * 0.8^2.
As mixed-aim, with Omen of Abyssal Echoes: 1 - 0.576^2.
No target is aimed on the revealed side: certain not to hit.
No pool and no target aimed on the side: certain not to hit.
An ordinary target is aimed but its exalt chance is unknown (placeholder weights): unknown.
No pool, an ordinary target whose exalt chance is unknown (a jewel), with the reroll: still unknown.
Five exclusive modifiers can be offered; the aimed one has two reachable tiers, one at or better than its floor, so it counts a half: 0.5 / 5.
